# Button

Buttons allow users to take actions, and make choices, with a single tap.

- **Import:** `import { Button } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/components-button--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { Button, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function ButtonExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Button onClick={() => {}} variant="default">
        Button
      </Button>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Button

It forwards its ref to `HTMLButtonElement`. Its props are `ButtonProps`, which extends `React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants>`.

- `isLoading`: `boolean`, optional.
- `emotion`: `ButtonEmotion`, optional.

  What the button means. Leave it unset and the variant renders exactly as
  it always has: `secondary` is `neutral` and `destructive` is `danger`
  already, by the values in the tokens. Set it and the emotion decides the
  colour, whatever the variant.

  `glass` takes no emotion.

- `size`: `"sm" | "lg" | "default" | "icon" | null`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `variant`: `"link" | "default" | "destructive" | "outline" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "glass" | null`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### ButtonEmotion

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type ButtonEmotion = (typeof BUTTON_EMOTIONS)[number];
```

## Also exported

- `BUTTON_EMOTIONS`: `readonly ["themed", "neutral", "success", "danger", "informative", "alert"]`. The six emotions the product drives, and which `Components.{Primary, Secondary,Tertiary} Buttons` have carried in the tokens since before this prop existed.
- `buttonVariants` (const).

  ```ts
  const buttonVariants: (
    props?:
      | ({
          variant?:
            | "link"
            | "default"
            | "destructive"
            | "outline"
            | "secondary"
            | "ghost"
            | "glass"
            | null
            | undefined;
          size?: "sm" | "lg" | "default" | "icon" | null | undefined;
        } & ClassProp)
      | undefined,
  ) => string;
  ```
